[[Yammiron's Focus]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Yammiron, Ether Lord]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[The Mirror of Lyss]] dyed purple.

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Domination Magic]])
:Halves casting time of [[Domination Magic]] [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%)
:[[Domination Magic]] +1 (20% chance while using [[skill]]s)

==Skin==
This item uses the same model as the [[Wooden Chakram]] and [[Inscribed Chakram (wooden)]]. 
* However, it has a unique appearance because the cloth features a deep red, almost [[w:Burgundy (color)|burgundy]] color, whereas the non-unique [[skin]]s cannot be dyed and have a desaturated purple, rather lavender-colored cloth.
* [[The Mindsquall]] also uses this model with a unique coloring, featuring an even darker red tone on the cloth.

**[[Asuran Focus]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Focus]] from collector [[Zaishen Mesmeric Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Focus]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
